description:
This small mod adds 2 new ships, 6 variant ships from Vanilla, 1 Fighter, 1 Bomber, 1 Interceptor, and 9 weapons. Independents know the ship's blueprints, and the weapons and fighters are rare blueprints in the wild. This mod's ships and weapons are designed to be superior to vanilla.

I hope everyone can enjoy this mod. Any problems, dm here.

Here are the ships:
The Cataphract:

A variant of the old Onslaught class design. It was updated by Elite ships and Variants(ESV) Corporation engineers. It has distributed fire control, heavy ballistic integration, 1 large missile, 1 large ballistic, 2 medium missiles, 7 medium ballistic, and 2 fighter bays.

The Hawk:

The Hawk is the latest ship from the Eagle and Falcon class lineage. The Hawk is a light cruiser that focuses on front-facing ballistics and is equipped with ammo feeders. While fielding impressive firepower, the ship itself is quite fragile and relies on hit-and-run tactics and the range of its weapons to stay alive. It has A Dedicated target core, 4 medium ballistic, 5 composite and 2 small ballistic slots.

The Heron EX:

The EX version of the Heron features additional wings and a focus on missiles: 1 large missile, 2 medium, 2 small ballistic slots.

The Tarsus EX:

The EX version is a highly modified and militarized version of the Tarsus. Making it competitive even among other state-of-the-art carriers. It has ECCM, 1 medium missile slot, 2 small ballistic slots, and 2 wing slots with a reserve deployment system.

The Enforcer EX C:

The EX is the state-of-the-art version of the Enforcer. The C version is modified to accept a wing. It has a maneuvering jet system.

The Enforcer EX M:

The EX is the state-of-the-art version of the Enforcer. The M version is modified to accept a large Missile slot. It has a fast missile rack system.

The Enforcer EX G:

The EX is the state-of-the-art version of the Enforcer. The G version is modified to accept a large ballistic slot. It has an ammo feed system.

The Wolf EX:

The EX version is a complete overhaul of the Wolf, making it a swift and versatile ship, but very fragile. It has a plasma jet system.

The Weapons:
-Ubirajara: Medium-range energy missile.
-Sabot Black Tip: A weaker sabot with longer range that regenerates the ammo.
-White Wall PD: Long-range accurate kinetic PD.
-Harpoon Blue Tip: a small fragmentation missile with large damage for anti-ship.
-Dynamic Impactor Mark IV: Short-range medium high explosive cannon.
-Long Range Precision Cannon: as the name implies.
-Particle Hyper Velocity Cannon: Long-range kinetic cannon.
-Kinetic Storm: Short-range, small assault kinetic gun.
-Blue Scarab: Short-range small assault high explosive gun.

The Fighters:

-Harpy: A fighter designed to hunt destroyers.
-Hellcry: A bomber designed to eliminate capital ships.
-Heaven Blaze: A drone interceptor designed to eliminate bombers and frigates.
